What to look for: both dxc panes fail to produce any SPIR-V output. The exit status is
non-zero and stderr prints a fatal internal-validation error/rejection instead of a
disassembly listing -- compare with a DXIL compile of the same source (cmd.txt's sibling,
`-T ps_6_7 -E PS`, no `-spirv`), which succeeds. The failure is triggered by the
RWTexture2DMS<uint4,2> declaration and its `.sample[]` subscript access; DXC's SPIR-V
backend produces an invalid multisample-resource variable type and its own embedded
validator refuses to emit it.
